newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss bankruptcies rise 9.6 pct in year to Nov 30.
newsitem.headline: Swiss bankruptcies rise 9.6 pct in year to Nov 30.

text.p: Commercial bankruptcies in Switzerland rose 9.6 percent in the 11 months to November 30 compared to the same period in 1995, a semi-official bankruptcy watchdog said on Wednesday.

Schweizerischer Verband Creditreform, a bureau which gives banks information on the creditworthiness of borrowers, said 3,880 commercial bankruptcy proceedings had been registered in the first eleven months of the year compared with 3,539 in the same 1995 period.
Including non-firm bankruptcy proceedings, total bankruptcy cases rose 3.7 percent to 9,193 versus 8,865 last year.
